caption: The drawing features a square textile or patterned design composed of an ornate floral motif. The central area is filled with a repeating pattern of stylized leaves and flowers rendered in off-white and black lines against a red background. Surrounding the central area is a border, which is wider on the left and bottom edges of the square. The border is filled with large, circular flower shapes and elongated leaves in shades of red, with black outlines and off-white backgrounds. There is a thin black-and-white band between the central area and the wider border, decorated with small, pointed, leaf-like shapes. The entire composition sits on a light beige paper, with handwritten notations along the bottom edge outside the border, including "Westchester County," a scale, and an ownership inscription.
title: Kerchief
